messages:
eva: Quick spike notes: tried progressive layerwise decrypt + streaming for encrypted safetensors. Goal: avoid full-model decrypt on cold start and reduce PCIe pressure.
jia: Sounds promising. How do you handle KMS calls without killing latency?
omar: Prototype flow: mint a short-lived signed header token once (HMAC over ckpt_id + exp). Loader uses token for local per-layer unwraps. KMS only on initial mint. For on-prem/VPC we support per-layer KMS mode if customer policy requires it.
ryan: Token-in-header is fine for hosted, but we need revocation and audit paths for enterprise. Also document the per-layer KMS fallback cost.
eva: Memory pattern: keep a tiny decrypted slab per GPU (4-8 layers), LRU eviction, zero on free. Peak decrypted << full model.
jia: Prefetch heuristics? Hot prefix access could thrash lower layers.
omar: Heuristic: when a layer is accessed >X times in T seconds, prefetch next N contiguous layers. Also a decrementing backoff to avoid runaway prefetch.
ryan: Add credit-based backpressure: runtime gives 'decrypt credits' to loader; loader decrypts only while credits available. Prevents huge decrypt storms on coldfan.
eva: Implemented token-bucket where each token == one layer decrypt or one microchunk. Refill based on SLO headroom.
warmup-bot: warmup-bot: starting warmup job id=wnp-942, model=redwood-m-70b-secure, mode=progressive-decrypt
warmup-bot: warmup-bot: logs:
```
[00:00:00] header fetch ok (token_exp=1700000000, meta_table_offset=4096)
[00:00:02] stream chunk 0..6MB -> ok
[00:00:03] decrypt layer 0 -> ok (18MB)
[00:00:04] populate GPU slab -> ok
[00:00:06] prefetch hint: layer1 hot -> issued 1 decrypt_credit
```
jia: How's the meta table encoded? We need per-layer offset/iv/aad/digest in order to stream.
omar: Header layout (sketch): magic|ver|kms_key|token_sig|meta_offset. Meta table: list of {offset, enc_len, iv, aad, digest}. Meta table compressed+signed but can be left unencrypted for manifestless streaming.
eva: Important trade: exposing offsets leaks layer sizes. Offer an opt-in full-header-encryption mode for high-sensitivity customers (cost: one KMS unwrap call to reveal meta).
ryan: Also consider atomicity and wipe-on-crash: for enterprise we must guarantee zeroing on eviction and on recovery boot. Document cuMemset + CPU overwrite and audit log emission.
jia: Metrics to add: per-layer-decrypt-latency_hist, decrypt_credit_utilization, resident_decrypted_bytes_avg, wasted_prefetch_count, fallback_variant_rate.
omar: Also track KMS_call_rate and token_mint_latency to decide auto-switch for tenants.
eva: Perf numbers from spike: cold-serving latency for first token ~220-320ms after hydrating first-layer kvroot+embeddings, peak_decrypted_mb ~120MB for the test model. Wasted prefetches low with tuned thresholds.
ryan: Next steps: 1) formal header+meta spec, 2) runtime credit API, 3) prefetch policy prototype + telemetry capture. Anyone claim items?
omar: I'll draft header/meta spec today.
eva: I'll run prefetch sensitivity experiments.
ryan: I'll PR a small decrypt-credit API tomorrow.
warmup-bot: warmup-bot: warmup complete job_id=wnp-942, peak_decrypted_mb=120, decrypt_ops=48, wasted_prefetch=2
